basic-965-v2-family-1.family: A family is a group of people related to one another, such as parents and children.
basic-965-v2-family-1.parent: A parent is a mother or father who raises and cares for a child.
basic-965-v2-family-1.mother: A mother is the woman who gives birth to a child or raises one.
basic-965-v2-family-1.father: A father is the man who has a child and helps care for them.
basic-965-v2-family-1.child: A child is a young person who has not yet become an adult.
basic-965-v2-family-1.kid: A kid is a child who is still growing up.
basic-965-v2-family-1.son: A son is a person's male child.
basic-965-v2-family-1.daughter: A daughter is a person's female child.
basic-965-v2-family-1.brother: A brother is a boy or man who has the same parent as you.
basic-965-v2-family-1.sister: A sister is a girl or woman who has the same parent as you.
basic-965-v2-family-1.sibling: A sibling is a brother or sister in the same family.
basic-965-v2-family-1.husband: A husband is a man who is married to someone.
basic-965-v2-family-1.wife: A wife is a woman who is married to someone.
basic-965-v2-family-1.grandson: A grandson is the son of someone's son or daughter.
basic-965-v2-family-1.grandmother: A grandmother is the mother of someone's mother or father.
basic-965-v2-family-1.grandfather: A grandfather is the father of someone's mother or father.
basic-965-v2-family-1.grandma: Grandma is an informal word for a grandmother.

basic-965-v2-family-2.granddaughter: A granddaughter is the daughter of someone's son or daughter.
basic-965-v2-family-2.uncle: An uncle is the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt.
basic-965-v2-family-2.aunt: An aunt is the sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle.
basic-965-v2-family-2.cousin: A cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
basic-965-v2-family-2.nephew: A nephew is the son of your brother or sister.
basic-965-v2-family-2.niece: A niece is the daughter of your brother or sister.
basic-965-v2-family-2.relative: A relative is a person who belongs to your family.
basic-965-v2-family-2.baby: A baby is a very young child who cannot walk or talk yet.
basic-965-v2-family-2.adult: An adult is a fully grown person, not a child.
basic-965-v2-family-2.teenager: A teenager is someone between the ages of 13 and 19.
basic-965-v2-family-2.people: The word people means more than one person.
basic-965-v2-family-2.person: A person is one human being.
basic-965-v2-family-2.man: A man is an adult male person.
basic-965-v2-family-2.woman: A woman is an adult female person.
basic-965-v2-family-2.boy: A boy is a male child.
basic-965-v2-family-2.girl: A girl is a female child.
basic-965-v2-family-2.marry: When two people marry, they become spouses.
basic-965-v2-family-2.wedding: A wedding is a ceremony where two people get married.
basic-965-v2-family-2.generation: A generation is a group of people born around the same time, such as parents and children.
